limitations: Do not sum parent and child stages, overlapping runs, or parallel API latencies as end-to-end elapsed time.
Audio duration and ASR billed audio seconds are not execution seconds.
Ledger API events and raw provider responses are deduplicated by responseId, fallback attemptId. Cache file copies and aggregate summaries are never counted again.
Saved responses without ledger have unknown latency and cost. No-ID ASR usage is excluded from combined totals to avoid unprovable duplication.
reasoningTokens is included in outputTokens; cached/cache-write tokens are input categories, not additional total tokens.

Local MLX token billing not applicable. Render report generationSeconds may describe only latest invocation; selected candidate units and inherited unit receipts must not be summed with earlier full renders.

Image_gen, operator waiting/listening and uninstrumented shell/UI work have no standalone duration/usage receipts here; unknown values remain null. Codex session usage is separately supplied by root in codex-usage.json and not added to API subtotal.
Document operation markers plus receipt createdAt give an interval envelope, not isolated PDF CPU/render time. No mtime used.
Historical benchmark/accounting files under work/*-runtime are unrelated copied repository fixtures and excluded.
Published/approved state follows final explicit human approval and HTTP hash verification, not earlier candidate receipts.
